en: A sepia-toned photograph shows a formal, tree-lined parkway beside a balustraded river or canal. There is an elegant European building, partly obscured by trees, in the background, and a bridge over water further along. The foreground features classical stonework and a wooden pergola. Cursive text on the front reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Am Fürstlichen Schloß'. The reverse side of the card contains museum-related branding, a publisher's note (Kunstverlagsanstalt Bruno Hansmann, Cassel.), printed postcard guidelines, and blank lines for message and address.
